symptom: factoryctl daemon-status and daemon-stop/start failed because tools.brain_loop imported tools.io_utils before adding D:\codex\orchestrator-mvp to sys.path, making module resolution depend on caller context.
impact: daemon control commands could crash before reaching runtime status
control session maintenance became impossible even though the daemon itself was healthy
the failure surfaced only when codex_control imported factory_daemon through the CLI path
fix: insert ROOT and bundled site-packages onto sys.path before any tools.* imports in tools/brain_loop.py
keep utility imports after path bootstrap to make daemon startup context-independent
validation: factoryctl daemon-status returned a live running daemon summary after the patch
